howth peninsula heritage society a talk in st. mary’s church of ireland, (beside howth castle main entrance) 8pm tuesday. 27th october 2026 eve gore-booth: irish radical poet and reformer . from lissadell house to industrial manchester, tracing a radical life at odds with an aristocratic heritage. the speaker is sonja tiernan, author and editor of 12 books including the bestselling volumes irish women’s speeches and the biography on eva gore-booth. admission for non members is €5. all are welcome. blessing of the graves mass for all those buried in the two cemeteries in the parish (saint mary’s and old abbey) will take place on sunday 1st november in the church at 11.30am . the blessing of the graves in both cemeteries will take place after the mass.
